diff --git a/libheif/image/pixelimage.cc b/libheif/image/pixelimage.cc
index 8120071..dbe9a7f 100644
--- a/libheif/image/pixelimage.cc
+++ b/libheif/image/pixelimage.cc
@@ -624,12 +624,12 @@ Error HeifPixelImage::extend_padding_to_size(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, bo
 
 Error HeifPixelImage::extend_to_size_with_zero(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, const heif_security_limits* limits)
 {
-  // This function only ever grows the image. A target smaller than the current
-  // size is out of contract: the per-row right-edge fill below computes its
-  // memset length as (subsampled_width - old_width), which would underflow to a
-  // huge value on a shrink request and write past the end of the pixel plane.
-  // Reject it up front (GHSA-hqc2-cx5m-g6ff).
-  if (width < m_width || height < m_height) {
+  // This function only ever grows the image. A request that would leave the image
+  // covering fewer pixels overall than before is out of contract: the per-row
+  // right-edge fill below computes its memset length as (subsampled_width -
+  // old_width), which would underflow to a huge value on a shrink request and
+  // write past the end of the pixel plane. Reject it up front (GHSA-hqc2-cx5m-g6ff).
+  if (static_cast<uint64_t>(width) * height < static_cast<uint64_t>(m_width) * m_height) {
     return Error{heif_error_Usage_error,
                  heif_suberror_Invalid_parameter_value,
                  "Cannot extend an image to a size smaller than its current size."};

@@ -679,12 +679,12 @@ Error HeifPixelImage::extend_padding_to_size(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, bo
 
 Error HeifPixelImage::extend_to_size_with_zero(uint32_t width, uint32_t height, const heif_security_limits* limits)
 {
-  // This function only ever grows the image. A target smaller than the current
-  // size is out of contract: the per-row right-edge fill below computes its
-  // memset length as (subsampled_width - old_width), which would underflow to a
-  // huge value on a shrink request and write past the end of the pixel plane.
-  // Reject it up front (GHSA-hqc2-cx5m-g6ff).
-  if (width < m_width || height < m_height) {
+  // This function only ever grows the image. A request that would leave the image
+  // covering fewer pixels overall than before is out of contract: the per-row
+  // right-edge fill below computes its memset length as (subsampled_width -
+  // old_width), which would underflow to a huge value on a shrink request and
+  // write past the end of the pixel plane. Reject it up front (GHSA-hqc2-cx5m-g6ff).
+  if (static_cast<uint64_t>(width) * height < static_cast<uint64_t>(m_width) * m_height) {
     return Error{heif_error_Usage_error,
                  heif_suberror_Invalid_parameter_value,
                  "Cannot extend an image to a size smaller than its current size."};
@@ -697,19 +697,21 @@ Error HeifPixelImage::extend_to_size_with_zero(uint32_t width, uint32_t height,
 
   // Preflight: no plane may shrink. Even when the logical target is not smaller
   // than the image, get_subsampled_size() can map it to a per-component size that
-  // is smaller than a plane's current size, e.g. a Cb/Cr plane that was added
-  // larger than the target's subsampled chroma extent. The per-row right-edge fill
-  // below would then compute its length as (subsampled_width - old_width), underflow
-  // uint32_t, and write past the end of the plane. Validate every plane before
-  // touching any so a rejected request cannot leave the image partially modified
-  // (GHSA-j2rv-58fh-w8pw, a follow-up to GHSA-hqc2-cx5m-g6ff whose logical-size
-  // guard above does not cover an individually oversized chroma plane).
+  // covers fewer total pixels than a plane's current size, e.g. a Cb/Cr plane that
+  // was added larger than the target's subsampled chroma extent. The per-row
+  // right-edge fill below would then compute its length as (subsampled_width -
+  // old_width), underflow uint32_t, and write past the end of the plane. Validate
+  // every plane before touching any so a rejected request cannot leave the image
+  // partially modified (GHSA-j2rv-58fh-w8pw, a follow-up to GHSA-hqc2-cx5m-g6ff
+  // whose logical-size guard above does not cover an individually oversized
+  // chroma plane).
   for (const auto& component : m_storage) {
     uint32_t subsampled_width, subsampled_height;
     get_subsampled_size(width, height, component.m_channel, m_chroma,
                         &subsampled_width, &subsampled_height);
 
-    if (subsampled_width < component.m_width || subsampled_height < component.m_height) {
+    if (static_cast<uint64_t>(subsampled_width) * subsampled_height <
+        static_cast<uint64_t>(component.m_width) * component.m_height) {
       return Error{heif_error_Usage_error,
                    heif_suberror_Invalid_parameter_value,
                    "Cannot extend an image to a size smaller than an existing plane."};

coupling: HeifPixelImage::extend_to_size_with_zero() (libheif/image/pixelimage.cc) only ever grows an image; its per-row right-edge fill computes a memset length as (subsampled_width - old_width), which underflows uint32_t and writes gigabytes past the plane if any plane is asked to shrink. Two real, independent commits each add a guard against this: commit 2ca70cf adds a whole-image logical-size check at the top of the function, and commit 6a83387 (a documented follow-up, 'this backstops the GHSA-hqc2-cx5m-g6ff logical-size guard, whose whole-image check does not see an individually oversized chroma plane') adds a second, per-plane preflight loop before any plane is touched. Each guard, as written upstream, independently compares the requested width against the current width and the requested height against the current height. The edit changes both guards, in exactly the same way, from a per-dimension comparison (width < old_width || height < old_height) to a total-pixel-count comparison (width*height < old_width*old_height, respectively for the per-component sizes). A request that shrinks one dimension while growing the other enough that the total pixel count does not decrease (e.g. a 100x5 image asked to extend to 50x200: area goes from 500 to 10000, but the width shrinks from 100 to 50) slips past an area-based check but is still a genuine per-plane shrink that the vulnerable memset cannot handle. Reverting only the 2ca70cf hunk (restoring the per-dimension check at the top) still leaves the 6a83387 per-component preflight loop with the area-based mistake, but that loop independently catches this exact input for a plain Y-only image (get_subsampled_size for a non-Cb/Cr channel returns the requested width/height unchanged, so the per-component check sees the same 50<100 shrink and rejects it) -- so the bug is not reachable with only that one commit edited. Symmetrically, reverting only the 6a83387 hunk (restoring the per-component per-dimension check) leaves 2ca70cf's area-based top-level check, but that check runs first and unconditionally returns before the preflight loop is ever reached, so it alone also safely rejects the crafted request. Only when both guards are simultaneously weakened to the same area-based comparison does the request pass both checks and reach the underflowing memset. A correct fix must restore per-dimension comparison in both places; restoring only one leaves the other guard's identical mistake exploitable.

pocs.entry_point: heif_image_extend_to_size_fill_with_zero (reached via heif_image_create + heif_image_add_plane, all public API)
